description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder' which serves as a base implementation for building responses to 'live' commands related to modification operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains methods for setting response and event creation functions, and for building a 'LiveCommandAnswer'.

classes.name: AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing a builder pattern for constructing responses to live commands that modify state, supporting optional response and event creation.

methods.name: AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with a command; ensures command is not null.

methods.name: withResponse
methods.description: Sets a function to create a CommandResponse when building the answer.

methods.name: withoutResponse
methods.description: Indicates no response should be included in the answer.

methods.name: withEvent
methods.description: Sets a function to create an Event when building the answer.

methods.name: withoutEvent
methods.description: Indicates no event should be included in the answer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a LiveCommandAnswer using the configured response and event functions.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to create a CommandResponse from the response function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to create an Event from the event function.
